subject: Invoice delivery - portal preferred but need email copies for AP contact
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Arielle Soto <arielle.soto@orionhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-28T09:12:00Z
Subject: Invoice delivery - portal preferred but need email copies for AP contact

Hi Arielle —

Following up on the invoice delivery options for Orion Health (deal ORH-2027-1542). We can deliver invoices via the following primary channels:

- AP portal (preferred): push XML+PDF via your portal API (matching your invoice schema), or integrate via our connector to Coupa/Ariba.
- Email PDF: send invoices as PDF to a dedicated invoices@ or accounting@ address.
- SFTP / webhook: for bulk automated pickup.
- Peppol / e-invoice: if you require Peppol IDs.

Quick questions to lock the flow:
1) Please confirm the AP ingestion method you want (portal API / email PDF / SFTP / Peppol).
2) Billing contact for email copies (if you want both portal + email).
3) PO number(s) to reference on invoices (we have PO-ORH-8932 on file — confirm).
4) VAT / tax ID: please confirm the billing entity VAT number and whether reverse-charge applies.

Attached sample invoice and the PO we have on record.

If portal is the go-forward option we can attribute the invoices to either "Redwood Inference (sender)" or set the invoice originator field to "Orion Health (collector)" depending on your AP rules — Ben and Marissa on my CC can help configure routing and invoice metadata.

Target to go-live: we can start test sends 3 business days after confirmation.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
+1 415-555-0182
From: Arielle Soto <arielle.soto@orionhealth.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Marco Ruiz <marco.ruiz@orionhealth.com>, Orion Health Procurement <procurement@orionhealth.com>
Date: 2027-06-28T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery - portal preferred but need email copies for AP contact

Dylan —

Thanks for the clear options. Orion prefers the portal API for automated ingestion. A few items to confirm from our side:

- Portal: yes, please push XML+PDF. We need the XML to include a cost_center and project_code fields for our AP mapping.
- Billing contact for email copies: accounting@orionhealth.com (please send a copy of each invoice PDF there for our records).
- VAT: our billing entity VAT ID is GB123456789; reverse charge does not apply for these services.
- PO: confirmed PO-ORH-8932 — include this on every invoice.

Questions:
- Can you include remittance information and a separate field for the remit address in the XML?
- If the portal push fails, will Redwood send an immediate fallback email to accounting@? We need an SLA around re-delivery.

We can do a short test with one invoice next week. Also copying Marco (finance) and procurement on any billing authorization forms you need signed.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-28T16:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery - portal preferred but need email copies for AP contact

Dylan / Ben —

Thanks — sounds straightforward. Technical notes for configuration team (keeping Arielle's asks in mind):

- We can push XML payloads matching Orion's schema. Need a sample XML schema or example field mapping; Arielle, can you share the schema or a sample payload?
- We'll include PDF attachment + XML metadata containing: invoice_number, invoice_date, total, VAT_number, cost_center, project_code, remit_address, remit_bank_iban.
- Fallback behavior: if portal push fails (HTTP non-2xx or TLS handshake error), our runner will attempt 3 retries over 30 minutes. If all retries fail we will send the PDF to accounting@orionhealth.com and open an ops incident with you. We'll also log the failure in Console under the Orion namespace.
- Sender attribution: recommendation is to keep "Redwood Inference" as the invoice sender and populate an "invoice_originator" field as "Orion Health" only if you prefer that display in your AP UI. Some customers require the supplier name on the PDF to match the portal sender; confirm preference.

Action items:
- Arielle: share portal XML schema and confirm whether invoices should be sent from sender=redwood@invoices.redwood.com or sender=orion@redwood.com (we can support either).
- Ben / Ops: prepare test push (sample payload attached).

Marissa Cole
Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Arielle Soto <arielle.soto@orionhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marco Ruiz <marco.ruiz@orionhealth.com>
Date: 2027-06-29T14:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery - portal preferred but need email copies for AP contact

Arielle / Marco —

Summary and next steps so everyone is aligned:
1) Primary channel: portal API push with XML+PDF. You confirmed cost_center and project_code fields are required.
2) Fallback: if portal push fails after 3 retries, Redwood will send the invoice PDF to accounting@orionhealth.com and notify the ops contact.
3) PO: include PO-ORH-8932 on every invoice (we have this bound to the deal).
4) VAT: we will populate VAT ID GB123456789 on each invoice and set reverse-charge = false.
5) Sender attribution: we will use sender=redwood@invoices.redwood.com and populate invoice_originator="Orion Health" in the XML per your AP mapping (this keeps supplier name consistent on PDF but allows your UI to surface Orion where needed).
6) Test: ops will run a single test invoice on July 1, target go-live for production sends July 5, 2027 pending your confirmation after the test.
7) Authorization: please sign the billing delivery authorization (DocuSign link below) to allow Redwood to push into your portal and copy accounting on fallback emails.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/records/ABC123
Portal onboarding link: https://redwood.app/portal/onboarding/ORH-8932

Attachments: Redwood-invoice-sample.pdf, PO-ORH-8932.pdf

If that looks correct please reply "confirmed" or note changes and we will schedule the test.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
